title: Better Aggregation in Test-Time Augmentation
mechanism: Simple-mean TTA can turn correct predictions wrong; learn per-augmentation aggregation weights instead.
adaptation: D4 group (flips x rot90, label-safe, already in training aug) mean TTA on singles and ensemble first; then per-class per-transform weights fitted in 5-fold CV (val too small alone).
min_experiment: Arm: D4 mean TTA on 5 singles and the ensemble. Baseline: same checkpoints without TTA (paired). Metric: crack IoU, relF1@2, components >= 20 px, inactive IoU on clean 49 / CV. Kill: paired gain < 0.005 crack IoU on singles.
evidence: R: consistent gains over mean TTA across models, datasets and augmentations (classification).
prior_overlap: none; per-panel BN adaptation (failed) is test-time adaptation, not TTA; flip/rot/multi-scale TTA listed as open
